name: Anvil Gauntlets (forge-gauntlets)
status_values: not_started | in_progress | done | stand_in | pending_human | blocked
decisions: 2026-09-25: weapons come off the hero bodies; each chassis weapon is its own model attached to hand sockets (the user's decision, relayed by the workflow coordinator). Brax keeps bare forearms and hands; the rock forge-gauntlets are the anvil_gauntlets weapon (art/weapons/anvil_gauntlets/).
2026-09-25: no human artist for stage 2; the AI pipeline makes the production mesh at production quality (the user's decision, relayed by the workflow coordinator).

0_concept_reference.notes: The gauntlets are designed on Brax's approved front and turnaround sheet (gauntlet close-ups: basalt segments with lava in every gap, knuckle plates, bronze elbow cuff and hexagonal strap frame ending in a wrist ring).

1_blockout.notes: Brax's stage-1 TRELLIS.2 blockout (s202) gave the gauntlet dimensions (elbow ring, forearm, hand, fingertip reach). SCULPT REFERENCE ONLY.

2_production_mesh.produced_by: AI (Claude), tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_weapon.py + s2_gauntlet.py + s2_texture.py; no human artist
2_production_mesh.notes: Rigid left/right pair, open (concept) and closed-fist variants with identical topology (shared UVs/texture). Authored in the weapon socket frame (origin palm centre, +Y along the fingers, +Z out of the back of the hand). All pieces closed and manifold.

3_rig.notes: No skin: rigid. Stage 3 adds weapon_L / weapon_R sockets on GF_Hero_v1 at the documented frame; the objects parent to them with an identity local transform.

4_animation.notes: None of its own; open/fist variant swap is driven by the hero's punch clips.

5_export_validate.notes: Headless export to assets/models/weapons/anvil_gauntlets.glb, uncompressed (bevy_gltf 0.20). The final Hades-II bar is a human gate.

human_gates.gate: stage 2: the user's visual approval of the AI-made weapon model
